mentions.title: Antonelli pole shows Mercedes is 'finally seeing the results' of car upgrades
mentions.summary:
Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli reckons his United States Grand Prix pole is the reward for Mercedes' efforts to finetune its comprehensive but troubled Malaysia upgrade.
Antonelli held off Red Bull tandem Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar on Austin's Circuit of the Americas as Ferrari flattered to deceive in Saturday's qualifying shootout by taking fourth and fifth.

mentions.title: McLaren's aims for its final F1 2026 upgrades amid decline in form
mentions.summary:

"We're just a step behind."

mentions.title: F1 United States GP: Leclerc beats Verstappen to top FP1 in upgraded Ferrari
mentions.summary:
Ferrari driver Charles Leclerc pipped Red Bull's Max Verstappen to top first practice at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix in Austin.
Leclerc was just under a tenth faster than Verstappen in an upgraded Ferrari as he aims to deny the Dutchman and his in-form Red Bull team a hat-track of grand prix wins.
